notes: WalkPlay SchemeNo11; the Android USB attach filter is generated from this record at build time
unofficial support; not affiliated with CrinEar (core/Device.kt:68)
report 0x4B, 64 bytes on the wire (report id plus 63 payload bytes); report 0x54 exists and is not used (core/WalkPlay.kt:24-25; research/protocol/PROTOCOL.md:17-19)

one top-level Consumer Control collection (usage page 0x0C, usage 0x01); the Android transport takes HID interface 3 first, else the first HID interface (android/app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/chronosauros/contour/usb/HidTransport.kt:86-87; research/protocol/PROTOCOL.md:13,182-183)
the HID interface number differs between enumerations on the PC: MI_02 once, MI_03 another time; the match is on usage 0x0C (dac-lab:devices/crinear-protocol-micro.md)
USB product string and bcdDevice not recorded in the sources read (dac-lab:devices/crinear-protocol-micro.md)
Contour uses raw frequency and Q on the wire; devicePEQ's SchemeNo11 compensation (ratio 0.9775, cos-Nyquist Q) is deliberately left out (research/protocol/PROTOCOL.md:73-93; core/WalkPlay.kt:10-17)
reads are the 1.2.2 predicates and parsers, permissive (core/DeviceProtocol.kt:225-262); A/B uses TEMP_WRITE, proven RAM-only on the Micro (core/DeviceProtocol.kt:24, core/WalkPlay.kt:289-292)
the WalkPlay web tool's Volume slider is the preamp frame 01 03 02 00 g (-16..+6 dB); Contour offers -30..0 dB and keeps the positive part off until the level moves
no vendor tool or UAC feature drives hardware volume (a Feature Unit 0x10 exists, no official tool uses it)

sequence: every band write, 20 ms after it (120 ms after the last band)
commit 01 05, 20 ms; 01 17, 20 ms; TEMP_WRITE 01 0A 04 00 00 FF FF, 50 ms; FLASH_EQ 01 01 01, 0 ms, then 200 ms

reset.src: the official tool (EQ.Hangout.Audio / devicePEQ) has no reset (scope-kt-walkplay.md:182,190-192). The WalkPlay web tool's resetDevice (class s2, which SchemeNo11 resolves to) is decoded (walkplay-plan.md item 4, rank KOD): 01 03 02 00 00; eight flat PURE band frames (50/200/500/1000/2500/5000/10000/15000 Hz, Q 0.75, 0 dB, PK, length byte 0x18); 01 0A 04 00 00 FF FF; 01 01 00; 01 05 01..04; 01 17 00. Contour has it in the bench only (reset-plan micro --owner-consent, after a full backup, restored afterwards); not in the app, not run on a unit; what it erases beyond the EQ is unknown

hwVolume.src: UAC Feature Unit 0x10 exists on the Micro, but neither official tool drives it (scope-kt-walkplay.md:181,194-196); the Micro answered none of the WalkPlay extra commands 0x11/0x16/0x19/0x1B/0x1D (scope-kt-walkplay.md:170,180)

rangesAccepted.note: Eight bands, PK and LS, LP 8000 Hz, HP 100 Hz and the preamp written and read back byte for byte on the PC and on phones. The preamp is whole dB: +3 dB is accepted by the register but moved the level by +0.00 dB, so a positive preamp is not offered.

acoustic.note: At a 48 kHz stream the PK mix, the shelf mix with the emulated HS, LP 8000, HP 100 and the preamp -6 (level -6.00 dB) pass. The DSP plays the coefficient bytes at 93 750 Hz (96 000 x 125/128), so Contour designs them for 93 750 Hz and every case fits within 0.057 dB; shelves play the slope form.

persistence.note: A full commit was not checked over a power cycle; only TEMP_WRITE was seen to be RAM-only (the earlier state came back after unplugging).

settings.note: The mic gain row is read only: the unit takes the write for some values only (phone -3 accepted, -1 ignored; PC -1 ignored). No DAC Settings row is offered.

tested.beyondVendor: CrinEar's tool (EQ.Hangout.Audio, devicePEQ) offers eight bands with no reset and no volume. Contour adds a high shelf (sent as an inverted low shelf with the gain sum in the preamp) and, since 2026-10-25, LP and HP, and rounds the preamp to whole dB. The WalkPlay web tool has a reset, which Contour keeps in the bench only (not run on a unit).
